svg.aria-label: Daily doodle: 88th anniversary of the LNER Mallard steam locomotive world speed record — July 3, 2026 headline over an art-deco tableau of the streamlined Garter-Blue A4 Class 4468 Mallard rushing rightward with a chalk-white steam plume drifting up-left across the sky, four driving wheels spinning, horizontal speed streaks racing past, a brass-rimmed speedometer at right with the needle swept to 126 MPH, and a rail with sleepers grounding the base; subhead MALLARD 126.4 MPH WORLD STEAM RECORD 88 YEARS; tertiary LNER CLASS A4 № 4468 STOKE BANK JULY 3 1938
svg.text: MALLARD · 126.4 MPH · WORLD STEAM RECORD · 88 YEARS
LNER CLASS A4 № 4468 · STOKE BANK · JULY 3, 1938
